body:
Are you sure about this exponent check? Currently any integer image larger than 8bit will fall back to outputting uint8, even if the source were 32bit. Removing it would let uint16 or higher use half float to retain precision.

Though, depending how the texture encoders are set up, it may require an option/button to downsample to uint8 anyway... Thought I'd mention it regardless.
Images with more than 8 bits per channel already load as half floats, not 8-bit. The tests check this with the 16-bit sample files which load in half-float formats.
